description: This file defines a React component called TopRecommendations, which fetches, filters, and displays a list of top high-priority recommendations, including UI helpers like badges and skeleton loaders. It interacts with external services to get recommendations and formats data for presentation.

methods.name: SeverityBadge
methods.description: Renders a badge indicating the severity level of a recommendation, styled according to severity.

methods.name: SavingsPill
methods.description: Displays formatted savings amount, styled as a pill.

methods.name: SkeletonRow
methods.description: Renders a placeholder row for loading states.
